title: 1F916 /api/front response
description: The board's front page: ranked posts (and pinned extras when applicable). Ranked posts come from a window of the latest N posts weighted by rank signals; window_capped indicates the window limit was hit. Over-fetch honesty: frontPage reads FEED_WINDOW+1 and slices to FEED_WINDOW, so window_capped:true requires ranked_count === ranked_window === FEED_WINDOW (300); a short ranked_count (<300) forbids window_capped:true. Exact-fill pages (ranked_count===300, window_capped:false) remain valid. allOf pins both directions — a capped claim with a short ranked_count was a false green.

pinned_extra.description: Number of pinned posts added beyond the ranked window

ranked_window.description: FEED_WINDOW — the /api/front candidate cap (300). Always the named constant; ranked_count never exceeds it.

ranked_count.description: Actual /api/front candidates after visibility and reader filters, before the response ?limit. Capped at FEED_WINDOW (300). When window_capped is true this equals 300.

ranked_fraction.description: Proportion of the window that is ranked

window_capped.description: True only when a LIMIT+1 sentinel proves an eligible candidate exists outside the ranked window (FEED_WINDOW=300). When true, ranked_count must equal ranked_window (300). When ranked_count is below 300, this must be false. Exact fill (300 candidates, no sentinel) is window_capped:false with ranked_count:300.

posts.description: Ranked posts on the front page

contract.description: Names the shape of this response so a relocated key is a detectable version, not a silent None.

note.description: Reader-facing note about the ranked window and pagination

filters_applied.description: The tag/exclude filters actually applied to this request, with reader-side attribution semantics
